```python
def change_date_format(date_str):
    year, month, day = date_str.split("-")
    return f"{day}-{month}-{year}"
```

The shared note's suggestion of `dt[::-1]` doesn't work here. Reversing "2026-01-02" gives "20-10-6202", not "02-01-2026", so it would fail the assert. Splitting on "-" and reassembling the parts in day-month-year order is the correct approach.
